attributes.name: band container width
attributes.definition: Whether the section holding the content is a full-width band spanning the viewport.

values.definition: Content sits in a section that spans the full viewport width.
Content sits in a width-constrained container.

attributes.name: band background treatment
attributes.definition: How the background of the band behind the content is treated.

values.definition: Band filled with a solid saturated brand or mid-tone color such as blue.
Band is white, light neutral or transparent, blending with the page.
Statement does not state the background.

attributes.name: button style
attributes.definition: Visual treatment of buttons or call-to-action controls.

values.definition: Rectangular buttons with a visible border and no fill.
Buttons filled with a solid color.
Call to action presented as large text or heading rather than a button.

attributes.name: label typography
attributes.definition: Case and weight treatment of button or CTA text.
